meta.title: Bookshelf Exchange — a readers' exchange library
meta.description: A library readers trade between themselves: show the copy you have finished, find the one you have been hunting for, and talk it over before the book changes hands.

hero.title: Every book deserves a second reader
hero.lede: Small shelves traded between readers: show the copy you have finished, find the one that belongs on your shelf, and talk with its keeper before the book passes from hand to hand.

home.p01b: Record the book you have finished: its condition, its price if you sell it, or what you would swap it for.
home.p02b: Browse other readers' shelves and search by title, author, or ISBN.
home.p03b: Agree on a meeting or a delivery, then rate the exchange; trust is built one trade at a time.
home.colophon: Bookshelf Exchange — a readers' exchange library, open to all
home.localeNote: In Arabic and English, right to left and left to right.

auth.signInIntro: Return to your shelves and conversations; your next book is waiting.
auth.signUpIntro: One step from your first exchange, and a new shelf starts here.
auth.emailHint: We only use it to sign you in.
auth.usernameHint: 3 to 24 lowercase Latin letters, digits, or underscores.
auth.passwordHint: At least 8 characters, including a letter and a digit.
auth.displayNameHint: The name other readers will see.

errors.invalidCredentials: That email or password is not right.
errors.rateLimited: Too many attempts — try again in a few minutes.
errors.emailTaken: This email is already registered. Try signing in.
errors.usernameTaken: That username is taken. Choose another one.
errors.passwordWeak: Weak password: at least 8 characters, with a letter and a digit.
errors.generic: We could not complete that request. Please try again.

notFound.title: № 404 — This page is not on our shelves
notFound.body: Perhaps the book moved to another shelf, or the link was never on our catalogue.

error.title: The shelf gave way — something broke
error.body: We could not show this page. Try again, and tell us if the error repeats.

footer.tagline: Every book deserves a second reader
footer.availability: Open to readers in Egypt for now, with more shelves opening soon.
footer.colophon: A book exchange built on paper and ink, not advertising.
